problem:
The matrix $A$ and vectors ${b}_{1}$, ${b}_{2}$, ${b}_{3}$ are given below. Which of the vectors lie in $\text{Null}(A)?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 5 \\ 6 & -10 \\ 9 & 15\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 6\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Null Space of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
The matrix $A$ and vectors ${b}_{1}$, ${b}_{2}$, ${b}_{3}$ are given below. Which of the vectors lie in $\text{Null}(A)?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
A vector $b$ lies in $\text{Null}(A)$ if $Ab=0.$ So, we need to compute the product of $A$ and each of the given vectors and check whether it is equal to $0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A{b}_{1} & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}6 \\ -3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}39 \\ 9\end{aligned}]\ne 0\,\times  \\ A{b}_{2} & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}34 \\ 6\end{aligned}]\ne 0\,\times  \\ A{b}_{3} & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-33 \\ -7\end{aligned}]\ne 0\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, none of the vectors lies in $\text{Null}(A).$
